rawTitle.zh: 第 2 章 数据可视化流程

subtitle.zh: 从「拿到一张表」到「画出一张图」的完整链路
subtitle.en: The complete pipeline from "getting a table" to "drawing a chart"

explain.zh: 你的原案例
explain.en: Your Original Case

explain.zh: 3 个可视化流程模型：① 参考 Card 1999 模型绘制流程图（Box Flowcharts）→ ② Mackinlay 自动化准则 → ③ van Wijk 模型（含交互反馈）。
explain.en: 3 visualization pipeline models: ① Reference the Card 1999 model for box flowcharts → ② Mackinlay's automation principles → ③ van Wijk's model (with interaction feedback).

explain.zh: 原始图片是你的概念图。本节课用 D3 重画这张概念图，每个节点点击后能展开细节。
explain.en: The original image is your concept map. This lesson uses D3 to redraw this concept map — every node expands details when clicked.

explain.zh: 嵌入理论：可视化流程的三个经典模型
explain.en: Embedded Theory: Three Classic Models of the Visualization Pipeline

explain.zh: 模型作者 / 年份核心思想 Card 数据流模型 Card, Mackinlay & Shneiderman, 1999 原始数据 → 数据表 → 视觉结构 → 视图（嵌套变换 D→T→V→C/L/S） Mackinlay 自动化准则 Mackinlay 1986 对每种数据类型，自动选「量化准确性最高」的视觉通道（如：数值→位置、类别→色调） van Wijk 反馈模型 van Wijk 2005 View ⇆ Filter ⇆ Param ⇆ Other Views —— 强调交互反馈循环
explain.en: ModelAuthor / YearCore Idea Card Data Flow Model Card, Mackinlay & Shneiderman, 1999 Raw data → data table → visual structure → view (nested transformations D→T→V→C/L/S) Mackinlay's Automation Principles Mackinlay, 1986 For each data type, automatically pick the visual channel with the highest “quantitative accuracy” (e.g., quantitative → position, categorical → hue) van Wijk Feedback Model van Wijk, 2005 View ↔ Filter ↔ Param ↔ Other Views — emphasizing the interaction feedback loop

explain.zh: 核心教学要点：三个模型描述同一件事的不同侧面—— Card 给"管道"，Mackinlay 给"自动决策"，van Wijk 给"反馈环"。 三者是叠加关系，不是冲突关系。
explain.en: Core teaching points: the three models describe different facets of the same thing — Card gives you the “pipeline,” Mackinlay gives you “automated decisions,” and van Wijk gives you the “feedback loop.” They layer on top of each other rather than conflict.

zh: Card 模型：告诉你"transform 之后该 mapping，mapping 之后该 view"
Mackinlay：告诉你"mapping 这一步怎么自动决策"
van Wijk：告诉你"view 之后还要把用户操作 feed 回去"
en: Card model: tells you “after transform comes mapping, after mapping comes view”
Mackinlay: tells you “how to automate the mapping step”
van Wijk: tells you “after view, you still need to feed user actions back”

code.zh: 关键代码 ① SVG 流程图节点 + 箭头
code.en: Key Code — SVG Flowchart Nodes + Arrows

code.zh: 5 个 step 节点横向排列，相邻节点之间用 SVG marker 画的箭头连接。
code.en: 5 step nodes arranged horizontally, connected by SVG-marker-drawn arrows between adjacent nodes.

code.html: ⭐ // 1. 用 <defs> + <marker> 定义箭头 svg.append("defs").append("marker") .attr("id", "arrowhead") .attr("viewBox", "0 -5 10 10") .attr("refX", 8) // 箭头位置校准 .attr("markerWidth", 6) .attr("orient", "auto") // 跟随线方向旋转 .append("path").attr("d", "M0,-5L10,0L0,5").attr("fill", "#94a3b8"); ⭐ // 2. 用 marker-end 引用箭头（重要） svg.append("line") .attr("marker-end", "url(#arrowhead)") .attr("x1", x1).attr("y1", y).attr("x2", x2).attr("y2", y); ⭐ // 3. 节点 ↔ 数据 绑定：d3.data + click 事件 svg.selectAll(".node").data(nodes) .join("g") .on("click", (event, d) => { // ⭐ 关键：classed 是 D3 状态管理核心 API svg.selectAll(".node").classed("selected", n => n.id === d.id); document.getElementById("d-4-1-detail").innerHTML = d.detail; });
code.text: ⭐ // 1. 用 <defs> + <marker> 定义箭头 svg. append ( "defs" ). append ( "marker" ) . attr ( "id" , "arrowhead" ) . attr ( "viewBox" , "0 -5 10 10" ) . attr ( "refX" , 8 ) // 箭头位置校准 . attr ( "markerWidth" , 6 ) . attr ( "orient" , "auto" ) // 跟随线方向旋转 . append ( "path" ). attr ( "d" , "M0,-5L10,0L0,5" ). attr ( "fill" , "#94a3b8" ); ⭐ // 2. 用 marker-end 引用箭头（重要） svg. append ( "line" ) . attr ( "marker-end" , "url(#arrowhead)" ) . attr ( "x1" , x1). attr ( "y1" , y). attr ( "x2" , x2). attr ( "y2" , y); ⭐ // 3. 节点 ↔ 数据 绑定：d3.data + click 事件 svg. selectAll ( ".node" ). data (nodes) . join ( "g" ) . on ( "click" , (event, d) => { // ⭐ 关键：classed 是 D3 状态管理核心 API svg. selectAll ( ".node" ). classed ( "selected" , n => n.id === d.id); document. getElementById ( "d-4-1-detail" ).innerHTML = d.detail; });

code.zh: 关键点解释： marker-end="url(#arrowhead)" 是 SVG 引用的方式 —— 把 <defs> 里定义的形状"嵌入"到线段末端； classed("selected", predicate) 接收布尔函数，一次性切换所有节点的"selected"状态，避免自己写 forEach。
code.en: Key explanation: marker-end="url(#arrowhead)" is SVG's referencing mechanism — it “embeds” a shape defined inside <defs> at the line's end; classed("selected", predicate) takes a boolean function and toggles the “selected” state of every node in one call, so you avoid writing forEach yourself.

demo.zh: 👆 点击任一节点查看在 Card / Mackinlay / van Wijk 三个模型中的对应
demo.en: 👉 Click any node to see its mapping in the Card / Mackinlay / van Wijk models

title.zh: 数据分类树（d3.rollup 多层聚合）

subtitle.zh: 把"按专业分"变成"按维度组合分"
subtitle.en: From “group by major” to “group by dimension combinations”

explain.zh: 📌 本节在流程中的位置：数据变换（Data Transformation）
explain.en: 📌 Where This Sits: Data Transformation

explain.zh: Card 1999 数据流模型把可视化拆成四段： 原始数据 → (变换) → 数据表 → (映射) → 视觉结构 → (渲染) → 视图。 本节讲的 2.2，就是第一段箭头 「原始数据 → 数据表」—— 这正是 数据变换（Data Transformation）。
explain.en: The Card 1999 data-flow model splits visualization into four stages: raw data → (transform) → data table → (map) → visual structure → (render) → view. Section 2.2 is the first arrow, “raw data → data table” — i.e. Data Transformation.

explain.zh: 你的原案例
explain.en: Your Original Case

explain.zh: 用新生数据按 "专业 / 班级" 做 rollup 分桶聚合。 你演示的核心是 d3.rollup 的链式调用 —— 一个函数完成多维度分组。
explain.en: Use the freshman data to do rollup bucketed aggregation by “major / class”. The core of your demo is d3.rollup's chained calls — one function that performs multi-dimensional grouping.

explain.zh: 理论补丁：数据变换的四大操作（Card 1999 D 层）
explain.en: Theory Patch: Four Operations of Data Transformation (Card ’s D layer)

explain.zh: 从「原始数据」到「数据表」，D 层做四类操作（注意：原文 4.2 节只讲了"分桶聚合"，这里把它放到完整的数据变换框架里）：
explain.en: Going from “raw data” to a “data table,” the D layer performs four kinds of operations:

explain.zh: 操作做什么D3 实现 清洗 / 过滤 (clean / filter)去缺失、去异常、筛选满足条件的行.filter()、d3.csv(row) 回调 聚合 / 汇总 (aggregate)按 key 分组，把同组归约为一个值d3.rollup()、d3.group() 连接 / 关联 (join)按键把两张表拼起来（如把学生表 join 班级表）d3.map + 手动索引 派生 / 衍生 (derive)由已有列算出新列（如从"班级"切出"专业"）row 回调里算一个新字段
explain.en: OperationWhat it doesD3 implementation Clean / filterRemove missing/outliers; keep rows matching a condition.filter(), d3.csv(row) callback AggregateGroup by key, reduce each group to a single valued3.rollup(), d3.group() JoinCombine two tables by key (e.g., student table joined to class table)d3.map + manual indexing DeriveCompute a new column from existing ones (e.g., extract “major” from “class”)compute a new field in the row callback

explain.zh: 本节演示的 rollup 聚合，属于"聚合"这一行。但读懂这张表，你才知道 数据变换是整个可视化流水线的"第一公里" —— 数据表没整理好，后面映射/渲染全都白搭。
explain.en: The rollup aggregation demonstrated here belongs to the “aggregate” row. But reading this table, you realize data transformation is the “first kilometer” of the whole pipeline — if the data table isn't clean, all the mapping and rendering downstream is wasted.

explain.zh: 嵌入理论：函数式聚合与 OLAP 切片
explain.en: Embedded Theory: Functional Aggregation and OLAP Slicing

explain.zh: d3.rollup 是"按 key 分桶、再 reduce 一次"的函数式组合：
explain.en: d3.rollup is a functional composition of “bucket by key, then reduce once”:

explain.html: const result = d3.rollup( data, // 输入数组 v => v.length, // reducer d => d.major, // key1（外层） d => d.class // key2（内层，可选） );
explain.text: const result = d3. rollup ( data, // 输入数组 v => v.length, // reducer d => d.major, // key1（外层） d => d.class // key2（内层，可选） );

explain.zh: 它返回 Map（不是数组、不是对象），所以：
explain.en: It returns a Map (not an array, not an object), so:

zh: 遍历用 for ([k, v] of m) 或 m.entries()
嵌套 rollup 出嵌套 Map
与 d3.group 的差别：rollup 把组内数据归约成一个值，group 保留原数组
en: Iterate using for ([k, v] of m) or m.entries()
Nested rollup produces a nested Map
Difference from d3.group: rollup reduces the in-group data to a single value, while group preserves the original array

explain.zh: 理论补丁：OLAP 切片/切块/钻取
explain.en: Theory Patch: OLAP Slice / Dice / Drill

explain.zh: 1993 年 Codd 提出 OLAP 12 条准则，其中 3 个核心操作用 rollup 就能模拟：
explain.en: In 1993 Codd proposed 12 OLAP rules; three of their core operations can be simulated with rollup:

zh: 切片 (Slice)：固定一维度（如只看 2025 级）→ 等价于 .filter() 后 rollup
切块 (Dice)：按两个维度分组 → 等价于双 key rollup
钻取 (Drill)：层层下钻 → 等价于嵌套 rollup + 递归展开
en: Slice: fix one dimension (e.g., only look at the 2025 cohort) → equivalent to .filter() then rollup
Dice: group by two dimensions → equivalent to a double-key rollup
Drill: drill down level by level → equivalent to nested rollup + recursive expansion

explain.zh: 教学要点：可视化系统的"下钻交互"通常背后就是 rollup + hierarchy 的组合。本节课演示 d3.rollup 的多层级能力。
explain.en: Classroom Takeaway: a visualization system's “drill-down interaction” is typically backed by a combination of rollup + hierarchy. This lesson demonstrates d3.rollup's multi-level capability.

code.zh: 关键代码 ① 双层 rollup
code.en: Key Code — Double-layer Rollup

code.zh: 两层 key：外层 = 专业，内层 = 班级，reducer = 计数。
code.en: Two key layers: outer = major, inner = class, reducer = count.

code.html: ⭐ // 双层 rollup：返回嵌套 Map，外层 key=专业，内层 key=班级 const nested = d3.rollup( students, v => v.length, // 每组聚合为单一值（这里是 count） d => d.major, // 外层 key d => d.class // 内层 key（rest 参数，可继续加） ); // 遍历嵌套 Map： for (const [major, inner] of nested) { for (const [cls, count] of inner) { console.log(major, cls, count); } }
code.text: ⭐ // 双层 rollup：返回嵌套 Map，外层 key=专业，内层 key=班级 const nested = d3. rollup ( students, v => v.length, // 每组聚合为单一值（这里是 count） d => d.major, // 外层 key d => d.class // 内层 key（rest 参数，可继续加） ); // 遍历嵌套 Map： for ( const [major, inner] of nested) { for ( const [cls, count] of inner) { console. log (major, cls, count); } }

code.zh: 关键点解释： d3.rollup 的 key 参数是rest 参数（...keys），所以传 1 个 → 单层 Map，传 2 个 → 嵌套 Map，传 3 个 → 3 层嵌套。 这就是 OLAP 的"维度组合"。
code.en: Key explanation: The key parameter of d3.rollup is a rest parameter (...keys), so passing 1 → single-layer Map, 2 → nested Map, 3 → 3-layer nesting. This is OLAP's “dimension combination.”

code.zh: 关键代码 ② 用正则提取专业
code.en: Key Code — Extract the Major via Regex

code.zh: CSV 里只有"班级"字段（"软件工程1班"），需要用正则切出"专业"和"班级序号"。
code.en: The CSV only has a “class” field (e.g., “Software Engineering Class 1”), so a regex is needed to split out the “major” and the “class number.”

code.html: ⭐ // d3.csv 第二参 row 回调里逐行 transform const data = await d3.csv("./data/newstudent.csv", d => { const cls = d["班级"].trim(); const m = cls.match(/^(.+?)(\d+班)$/); // 中间非贪婪 + 末尾"数字+班" return { id: +d["序号"], name: d["姓名"].trim(), class: cls, major: m ? m[1] : cls, // "软件工程1班" → "软件工程" }; });
code.text: ⭐ // d3.csv 第二参 row 回调里逐行 transform const data = await d3. csv ( "./data/newstudent.csv" , d => { const cls = d[ "班级" ]. trim (); const m = cls. match ( /^(.+?)(\d+班)$/ ); // 中间非贪婪 + 末尾"数字+班" return { id: +d[ "序号" ], name: d[ "姓名" ]. trim (), class: cls, major: m ? m[ 1 ] : cls, // "软件工程1班" → "软件工程" }; });

code.zh: 关键点解释： 正则 /^(.+?)(\d+班)$/ 的 .+? 是非贪婪匹配，会让中间尽可能短、末尾留给 \d+班。 没这个非贪婪：.+ 会把整串都匹配走，剩下空，m[1] 就是 undefined。 这类正则坑学生常踩，必须掌握。
code.en: Key explanation: In the regex /^(.+?)(\d+班)$/, the .+? is non-greedy matching — it keeps the middle as short as possible and leaves the tail for \d+班. Without non-greedy: .+ would consume the whole string, leaving nothing, and m[1] would be undefined. This is a regex pitfall students frequently step on; you must master it.

subtitle.zh: 层级数据 → 屏幕坐标的算法核心
subtitle.en: The algorithmic core of hierarchical data → screen coordinates

explain.zh: 📌 本节在流程中的位置：视觉映射（Visual Mapping）
explain.en: 📌 Where This Sits: Visual Mapping

explain.zh: 接上一节 2.2 数据变换，我们有了"数据表"。本节的 2.3 是第二段箭头 「数据表 → 视觉结构」 —— 也就是 视觉映射（Visual Mapping）。 它回答一个核心问题：数据里每个属性，该用哪个视觉通道来表达？
explain.en: Following the 2.2 data transformation, we now have a “data table.” Section 2.3 is the second arrow, “data table → visual structure” — i.e. Visual Mapping. It answers one core question: for each data attribute, which visual channel should express it?

explain.zh: 你的原案例
explain.en: Your Original Case

explain.zh: 你的 4.2 节提到"树形结构可视化"。这节展开树布局算法原理 —— 拿到层级数据后，怎么把节点摆到屏幕上不打架？
explain.en: Your Section 4.2 mentioned “tree-structure visualization.” This lesson expands on the tree layout algorithm — once you have hierarchical data, how do you place nodes on screen without overlap?

explain.zh: 理论核心：什么是视觉通道？Mackinlay 的排名
explain.en: Theory Core: What Is a Visual Channel? Mackinlay's Ranking

explain.zh: 视觉通道（visual channel）是指"把数据编码到视觉元素上"的载体： 位置、长度、面积、角度、颜色、形状、纹理…… Mackinlay 1986 给出经典排名：对不同数据类型，各通道的量化精确度不一样。 这就是下面这张图。
explain.en: A visual channel is the carrier that “encodes data onto a visual element”: position, length, area, angle, color, shape, texture… Mackinlay (1986) gave the classic ranking: for different data types, the quantitative accuracy of each channel differs. That is the figure below.

caption.zh: 图 1 · Mackinlay 1986 通道排名：对 Quantitative（定量）/ Ordinal（有序）/ Nominal（名义）三类数据，各通道的量化精确度排序。位置（Position）永远最准。
caption.en: Figure 1 · Mackinlay (1986) channel ranking: for Quantitative / Ordinal / Nominal data, the quantitative-accuracy ordering of each channel. Position is always the most accurate.

zh: 位置（Position）：三种数据类型都是第一 —— 人眼对位置最敏感
定量数据：长度 → 角度 → 斜率 → 面积（长条形图比面积图准）
名义数据：位置 → 色调（hue）→ 纹理 → 连接 → 形状
en: Position: ranks #1 for all three types — the eye is most sensitive to position
Quantitative data: length → angle → slope → area (bar charts beat area charts)
Nominal data: position → hue → texture → connection → shape

explain.zh: 理论核心：图元（marks）与视觉通道的构成
explain.en: Theory Core: Marks and the Composition of Visual Channels

explain.zh: 视觉结构由 图元（mark）打底：点（Point）、线（Line）、面（Area）。 然后通过 通道把这些图元"做记号"：位置、颜色、形状、倾斜、大小。 下面两张图拆开讲。
explain.en: The visual structure is built on marks: Point, Line, Area. These marks are then “marked up” through channels: position, color, shape, tilt, size. The next two figures break this apart.

caption.zh: 图 2 · 图元（marks）三族：点（Points）、线（Lines）、面（Areas）。图元决定"一份数据长什么样"，是视觉结构的骨架。
caption.en: Figure 2 · Three families of marks: Points, Lines, Areas. Marks determine “what a datum looks like” — the skeleton of the visual structure.

alt.zh: 视觉通道：位置/颜色/形状/倾斜/大小
alt.en: Visual channels: Position / Color / Shape / Tilt / Size

caption.zh: 图 3 · 常用视觉通道族：位置（Position，含水平/垂直/两者）、颜色（Color）、形状（Shape）、倾斜（Tilt）、大小（Size，含长度/面积/体积）。
caption.en: Figure 3 · Common visual-channel families: Position (horizontal / vertical / both), Color, Shape, Tilt, Size (length / area / volume).

explain.zh: 理论核心：两类通道 —— 幅度 vs 标识
explain.en: Theory Core: Two Channel Classes — Magnitude vs Identity

explain.zh: 按"能不能表达量的多少"，通道分两类： 幅度通道（Magnitude）表达有序/定量属性；标识通道（Identity）表达类别属性。 选错类别 = 误导读者。
explain.en: By “whether it can express magnitude,” channels split into two classes: Magnitude channels express ordered / quantitative attributes; Identity channels express categorical attributes. Picking the wrong class misleads readers.

caption.zh: 图 4 · 幅度通道（Magnitude Channels）：表达"有序属性"。按精确度排序 —— 共用尺度位置最准，长度/倾斜/面积次之，颜色亮度、饱和度和体积最弱（都标 "Same" 即排序有歧义）。
caption.en: Figure 4 · Magnitude Channels: express “ordered attributes.” Ordered by accuracy — position on a common scale is best; length / tilt / area next; color luminance, saturation, and volume are weakest (all marked “Same” — ambiguous ordering).

caption.zh: 图 5 · 标识通道（Identity Channels）：表达"类别属性" —— 空间区域、色调（hue）、运动（motion）、形状（shape）。它们能区分"不同类"，但分不出"谁多谁少"。
caption.en: Figure 5 · Identity Channels: express “categorical attributes” — spatial region, hue, motion, shape. They distinguish different categories but cannot rank “more vs less.”

explain.zh: 本节案例的落点：树布局（Reingold-Tilford）本质上就是一种视觉映射 —— 用 位置通道 把层级关系编码成"父在上、子在下的树"。下面讲它的算法。
explain.en: Where this lesson lands: tree layout (Reingold-Tilford) is essentially a visual mapping — it uses the position channel to encode hierarchy as “parent above, children below.” The algorithm follows.

explain.zh: 嵌入理论：Reingold-Tilford 算法（d3.tree 的核心）
explain.en: Embedded Theory: The Reingold-Tilford Algorithm (the core of d3.tree)

explain.zh: Reingold & Tilford 1981 年提出的算法，至今仍是 d3.tree() 的实现核心。核心思路：
explain.en: The algorithm proposed by Reingold & Tilford in 1981 is still the implementation core of d3.tree(). Core idea:

zh: 第一遍（自底向上）：对每个父节点，计算其左右子树"占用多少横向空间"
第二遍（自顶向下）：给每个节点分配绝对 x 坐标（保证兄弟节点紧贴父节点中线且不重叠）
第三遍：处理"线程"（threads）—— 修复子节点跨父中线时的对齐
en: First pass (bottom-up): for each parent node, compute how much horizontal space its left and right subtrees “occupy”
Second pass (top-down): assign every node an absolute x-coordinate (so siblings hug the parent's centerline without overlapping)
Third pass: handle “threads” — fix the alignment when children cross the parent's centerline

explain.zh: 复杂度的处理：
explain.en: Complexity handling:

zh: O(n) 时间 —— 比简单的"递归平分"要快
节点的左右子树宽度的最小值 = 至少容纳所有子节点的水平空间
不同布局策略选型：d3.tree（左右）、d3.cluster（左右紧贴）、d3.treemap（面积）
en: O(n) time — faster than a naive “recursive halving”
A node's minimum left/right subtree width = the horizontal space needed at minimum to hold all its children
Layout-strategy options: d3.tree (left-right), d3.cluster (left-right, packed), d3.treemap (area)

explain.zh: 理论补丁：d3-hierarchy 模块全家桶
explain.en: Theory Patch: The d3-hierarchy Module Family

zh: hierarchy(data)：把任意嵌套 data 转成 hierarchy 结构（每个节点加 parent/children/depth）
tree().size([h, w])：reingold-tilford 算法，左右布局
cluster().size([h, w])：所有叶子节点对齐到同一深度
treemap().tile(...)：面积（slice-and-dice / squarified / resquarify 算法）
pack().radius(d => ...)：圆环打包（circle packing）
partition().size([h, w])：icicle / sunburst 布局
en: hierarchy(data): convert any nested data into a hierarchy structure (each node gets parent / children / depth)
tree().size([h, w]): Reingold-Tilford algorithm, left-right layout
cluster().size([h, w]): align all leaf nodes to the same depth
treemap().tile(...): area-based (slice-and-dice / squarified / resquarify algorithms)
pack().radius(d => ...): circle packing
partition().size([h, w]): icicle / sunburst layout

code.zh: 关键代码 ① hierarchy + tree 三步走
code.en: Key Code — hierarchy + tree in Three Steps

code.zh: 这是 d3-hierarchy 的标准模式：先建 hierarchy、再求 tree layout、最后画 links + nodes。
code.en: This is the standard d3-hierarchy pattern: first build the hierarchy, then compute the tree layout, and finally draw links + nodes.

code.html: ⭐ // 1. hierarchy：从嵌套 JSON → 计算每个节点的 parent/children/depth const root = d3.hierarchy(rootData); ⭐ // 2. tree layout：给每个节点算 x/y 坐标 const treeLayout = d3.tree().size([360, 720]); const treeData = treeLayout(root); ⭐ // 3. 画 links：父-子连线（Reingold-Tilford 算法结果就在这里） g.selectAll(".link").data(treeData.links()).join("path") .attr("d", d3.linkHorizontal().x(d => d.y).y(d => d.x)); ⭐ // 4. 画 nodes：圆 + 文字 const ng = g.selectAll(".node").data(treeData.descendants()).join("g") .attr("transform", d => `translate(${d.y}, ${d.x})`); ng.append("circle").attr("r", 5); ng.append("text") .attr("text-anchor", d => d.children ? "end" : "start") .attr("x", d => d.children ? -8 : 8) .text(d => d.data.name);
code.text: ⭐ // 1. hierarchy：从嵌套 JSON → 计算每个节点的 parent/children/depth const root = d3. hierarchy (rootData); ⭐ // 2. tree layout：给每个节点算 x/y 坐标 const treeLayout = d3. tree (). size ([ 360 , 720 ]); const treeData = treeLayout (root); ⭐ // 3. 画 links：父-子连线（Reingold-Tilford 算法结果就在这里） g. selectAll ( ".link" ). data (treeData.links()). join ( "path" ) . attr ( "d" , d3. linkHorizontal (). x (d => d.y). y (d => d.x)); ⭐ // 4. 画 nodes：圆 + 文字 const ng = g. selectAll ( ".node" ). data (treeData. descendants ()). join ( "g" ) . attr ( "transform" , d => `translate( ${ d.y } , ${ d.x } )` ); ng. append ( "circle" ). attr ( "r" , 5 ); ng. append ( "text" ) . attr ( "text-anchor" , d => d.children ? "end" : "start" ) . attr ( "x" , d => d.children ? - 8 : 8 ) . text (d => d.data.name);

code.zh: 关键点解释： treeData.x 是深度方向（默认垂直），treeData.y 是水平方向（同一深度的不同节点）。 所以 linkHorizontal 用 x=d.y, y=d.x —— 横线方向走 y，垂直方向走 x。 这种"x 轴走 y、y 轴走 x"的 swap 是横向树特有的，记住。
code.en: Key explanation: treeData.x is the depth direction (vertical by default), while treeData.y is the horizontal direction (different nodes at the same depth). So linkHorizontal uses x=d.y, y=d.x — the horizontal direction rides on y, and the vertical direction rides on x. This “x-axis rides on y, y-axis rides on x” swap is unique to horizontal trees — commit it to memory.

code.zh: 关键代码 ② separation 控制父子间距
code.en: Key Code — separation Controls Parent-Child Spacing

code.zh: separation 接收函数，返回 [node, parent] 之间的"间隔倍数"。
code.en: separation accepts a function and returns the “spacing multiplier” between [node, parent].

code.html: const treeLayout = d3.tree() .size([360, 720]) .separation((a, b) => (a.parent === b.parent ? 1 : 2)); // ↑ 兄弟节点紧贴 ↑ 非兄弟至少隔 2 倍
code.text: const treeLayout = d3. tree () . size ([ 360 , 720 ]) . separation ((a, b) => (a.parent === b.parent ? 1 : 2 )); // ↑ 兄弟节点紧贴 ↑ 非兄弟至少隔 2 倍

code.zh: 关键点解释： separation 默认值 (a, b) => a.parent === b.parent ? 1 : 2。 改成 0.5 → 全部挤一起；改成 2.0 → 树变宽。 Demo 里有个 slider 让你实时调看效果。
code.en: Key explanation: The default value of separation is (a, b) => a.parent === b.parent ? 1 : 2. Change it to 0.5 → everything squishes together; change it to 2.0 → the tree widens. There is a slider in the demo so you can adjust it in real time and see the effect.

demo.zh: 👆 切换聚合层次（专业→班级 / 性别→专业→班级 等），滑动 slider 调 separation 看效果 · 这就是用「位置通道」做视觉映射
demo.en: 👉 Switch aggregation levels (major → class / gender → major → class, etc.) and drag the slider to adjust separation · this is visual mapping via the “position channel”

title.zh: 树形列表渲染（classed + 事件委托）

subtitle.zh: 把树画成可折叠的 HTML 列表，处理点击、冒泡、委托三个坑
subtitle.en: Render the tree as a collapsible HTML list — handling three pitfalls: click, bubbling, and delegation

explain.zh: 📌 本节在流程中的位置：视图渲染 + 用户交互
explain.en: 📌 Where This Sits: View Rendering + User Interaction

explain.zh: 接上节 2.3 视觉映射，我们有了"视觉结构"。本节 2.4 是最后两段箭头： 「视觉结构 → 视图」（渲染） 和 「视图 ↔ 用户」（交互反馈）。 Card 模型的 V 层，加上 van Wijk 的反馈环，都落在这里。
explain.en: Following the 2.3 visual mapping, we now have a “visual structure.” Section 2.4 covers the last two arrows: “visual structure → view” (rendering) and “view ↔ user” (interaction feedback). Card's V layer and van Wijk's feedback loop both land here.

explain.zh: 你的原案例
explain.en: Your Original Case

explain.zh: 原文档用了 classed 控制节点样式、用 stopPropagation 阻止冒泡。重点是把 D3 树布局输出变成可交互的 HTML 列表。
explain.en: The original document used classed to control node styles and stopPropagation to block bubbling. The focus is on turning the D3 tree layout output into an interactive HTML list.

explain.zh: 嵌入理论：DOM 事件三阶段 + 事件委托
explain.en: Embedded Theory: The Three Phases of DOM Events + Event Delegation

explain.zh: 浏览器的事件流分三阶段（DOM 规范）：
explain.en: The browser's event flow has three phases (per the DOM spec):

zh: 捕获 (capturing)：window → document → ... → 目标元素（从外到内）
目标 (target)：目标元素本身
冒泡 (bubbling)：目标元素 → ... → document → window（从内到外）
en: Capturing: window → document → ... → target element (outside to inside)
Target: the target element itself
Bubbling: target element → ... → document → window (inside to outside)

explain.zh: 默认监听的是冒泡阶段。你可以在监听器里 e.stopPropagation() 截断冒泡，让上层的监听器不再触发。
explain.en: By default, listeners are registered on the bubbling phase. Inside a listener you can call e.stopPropagation() to cut off bubbling so ancestor listeners no longer fire.

explain.zh: 理论补丁：动画 —— 视图渲染的"时间维"（van Wijk 反馈的直观体现）
explain.en: Theory Patch: Animation — the “time dimension” of view rendering

explain.zh: 动画（transition）不是"花哨"，而是视图渲染在时间维上的展开。 D3 里用 .transition().duration(ms)， 让属性从旧值平滑过渡到新值。教学价值在 duration 这一个参数：
explain.en: Animation (transition) isn't “fancy” — it's the time dimension of view rendering. In D3 you use .transition().duration(ms) to smoothly interpolate an attribute from its old value to a new one. The pedagogical value lies in the single duration parameter:

zh: duration=0：瞬间跳变，师生"看不出变化过程"
duration=500：0.5 秒过渡，能看到展开/收缩/位移的流畅过程
duration>1500：太慢，学生开始走神
en: duration=0: instant jump — you can't “see the change happen”
duration=500: a 0.5 s transition — you see the expand / collapse / move smoothly
duration>1500: too slow — students start to drift

explain.zh: 本节的交互 demo 特意加了 duration 滑块， 让你现场改变这个参数，直观看到"渲染如何随时间展开"。这是理解"视图渲染 + 交互反馈"最直接的一课。
explain.en: This lesson's interactive demo adds a duration slider so you can change this parameter live and see “how rendering unfolds over time.” It's the most direct lesson on “view rendering + interaction feedback.”

explain.zh: 理论补丁：事件委托 (Event Delegation)
explain.en: Theory Patch: Event Delegation

explain.zh: 问题：列表里有 1000 个 li，给每个 li 都绑 click 监听器 → 慢、内存大、新增元素要重新绑。
explain.en: Problem: if a list has 1000 li elements and you bind a click listener to each → it's slow, memory-heavy, and newly added elements have to be re-bound.

explain.zh: 解法：只给父元素（ul/div）绑 1 个 click 监听器，利用冒泡机制 —— 子元素的 click 最终会触发父元素的监听器。用 e.target.closest('.label') 找到"实际点击的是哪个子元素"。
explain.en: Solution: bind only 1 click listener on the parent element (ul / div) and lean on bubbling — a click on any child eventually triggers the parent's listener. Use e.target.closest('.label') to figure out “which child element was actually clicked.”

explain.zh: 优势：1 个监听器代替 N 个、未来新增元素自动支持。
explain.en: Advantage: 1 listener replaces N, and any future newly added elements are automatically supported.

explain.zh: 关键 API：D3 classed()
explain.en: Key API: D3 classed()

explain.html: selection.classed("selected", true); // 1) 添加 class selection.classed("selected", false); // 2) 移除 class selection.classed("selected", d => d.id === pickId); // 3) 函数式批量切换
explain.text: selection. classed ( "selected" , true ); // 1) 添加 class selection. classed ( "selected" , false ); // 2) 移除 class selection. classed ( "selected" , d => d.id === pickId); // 3) 函数式批量切换

code.zh: 关键代码 ① 事件委托（一对多监听）
code.en: Key Code — Event Delegation (one-to-many listening)

code.zh: 用递归 buildList 构建可折叠树；用 liSel 上的 click 做事件委托，不绑到每个 label。
code.en: Use recursive buildList to construct the collapsible tree; use the click on liSel for event delegation rather than binding to each label.

code.html: ⭐ // 父 ul 上绑一次 click，所有子 li 共享 function buildList(liSel, d) { const label = liSel.append("span").attr("class", "label"); label.on("click.toggle", (event) => { // ⭐ 关键 ①：阻止冒泡 —— toggle 按钮不该触发"选中" event.stopPropagation(); d.data._collapsed = !d.data._collapsed; render(); }); liSel.on("click.select", (event) => { // ⭐ 关键 ②：如果 click 来自 toggle，已经被 stopPropagation 阻断，不会到这里 document.querySelectorAll("li").forEach(li => li.classList.remove("selected")); liSel.classed("selected", true); }); }
code.text: ⭐ // 父 ul 上绑一次 click，所有子 li 共享 function buildList (liSel, d) { const label = liSel. append ( "span" ). attr ( "class" , "label" ); label. on ( "click.toggle" , (event) => { // ⭐ 关键 ①：阻止冒泡 —— toggle 按钮不该触发"选中" event. stopPropagation (); d.data._collapsed = !d.data._collapsed; render(); }); liSel. on ( "click.select" , (event) => { // ⭐ 关键 ②：如果 click 来自 toggle，已经被 stopPropagation 阻断，不会到这里 document. querySelectorAll ( "li" ). forEach (li => li. classList . remove ( "selected" )); liSel. classed ( "selected" , true ); }); }

code.zh: 关键点解释： 这是经典的「阻止 toggle 按钮冒泡到 li 的 select 监听器」模式。如果不 stopPropagation， 点 toggle 时会同时触发"切换折叠"和"选中节点"，用户看着会困惑。 这是 DOM 事件机制的核心教学点。
code.en: Key explanation: This is the classic pattern of “stopping the toggle button from bubbling up to the li's select listener.” Without stopPropagation, clicking the toggle would simultaneously trigger “toggle collapse” and “select the node,” which would confuse users. This is a core teaching point about the DOM event mechanism.

code.zh: 关键代码 ② 嵌套递归 buildList
code.en: Key Code — Nested Recursive buildList

code.zh: d3 selection 的递归渲染：每个 li 内部再有 ul/li，再递归 buildList。
code.en: Recursive rendering with d3 selections: every li contains another ul/li, then buildList recurses into it.

code.html: function render() { $tree.innerHTML = ""; const ul = d3.create("ul"); ul.selectAll("li").data([root]).join("li") .each(function(d) { buildList(d3.select(this), d); }); $tree.appendChild(ul.node()); }
code.text: function render () { $tree.innerHTML = "" ; const ul = d3. create ( "ul" ); ul. selectAll ( "li" ). data ([root]). join ( "li" ) . each ( function (d) { buildList (d3. select ( this ), d); }); $tree. appendChild (ul. node ()); }

code.zh: 关键代码 ③ D3 过渡动画（transition + duration）
code.en: Key Code — D3 Transition (transition + duration)

code.zh: 视图渲染的"时间维"：让节点展开/收缩时平滑过渡，不是瞬间跳变。duration 由滑块实时控制。
code.en: The “time dimension” of view rendering: smoothly interpolate node expand / collapse instead of an instant jump. duration is controlled by a live slider.

code.html: ⭐ // 关键：transition + duration = 让属性随时间平滑变化 svg.selectAll(".node") .transition() // 进入过渡状态 .duration(DURATION) // 时长（ms），滑块控制 .attr("transform", d => `translate(${d.y}, ${d.x})`) .attr("opacity", 1); // 新节点进入时：先设 opacity=0，再过渡到 1 → 淡入效果 ng.attr("opacity", 0) .transition().duration(DURATION).attr("opacity", 1);
code.text: ⭐ // 关键：transition + duration = 让属性随时间平滑变化 svg. selectAll ( ".node" ) . transition () // 进入过渡状态 . duration ( DURATION ) // 时长（ms），滑块控制 . attr ( "transform" , d => `translate(${d.y}, ${d.x})` ) . attr ( "opacity" , 1 ); // 新节点进入时：先设 opacity=0，再过渡到 1 → 淡入效果 ng. attr ( "opacity" , 0 ) . transition (). duration ( DURATION ). attr ( "opacity" , 1 );

code.zh: 关键代码 ④ 动画时长滑块（直接在 HTML/CSS 里控制）
code.en: Key Code — Animation Duration Slider

code.html: <!-- HTML 滑块：监听 input 事件即可改 DURATION --> <input id="dur" type="range" min="0" max="1500" step="50" value="500"> // JS：改变 DURATION 后重放动画 document.getElementById("dur").addEventListener("input", e => { DURATION = +e.target.value; render(); // 用新时长重新做一次过渡 });
code.text: <!-- HTML 滑块：监听 input 事件即可改 DURATION --> <input id="dur" type="range" min="0" max="1500" step="50" value="500"> // JS：改变 DURATION 后重放动画 document. getElementById ( "dur" ). addEventListener ( "input" , e => { DURATION = +e.target.value; render(); // 用新时长重新做一次过渡 });

code.zh: 关键点解释： 为什么用 innerHTML = "" 清空再重画？ D3 没有"智能更新"树结构（层级变化）的 API —— 节点展开/折叠会改变父子结构，最简单的做法是全量重新渲染。 用 selection.each() 配合 d3.select(this) 把原生元素转回 selection，这是 D3 与原生 DOM 互操作的关键模式。
code.en: Key explanation: Why use innerHTML = "" to clear and redraw? D3 has no “smart-update” API for tree structures (where hierarchy changes) — expanding or collapsing a node changes the parent-child structure, and the simplest approach is a full re-render. Use selection.each() together with d3.select(this) to convert the raw element back into a selection — this is the key pattern for D3-native-DOM interop.

demo.zh: 👆 点击三角形 toggle 折叠/展开 · 点击条目本身选中（看下方日志）· 拖动「动画时长」滑块看 transition 效果
demo.en: 👉 Click the triangle to toggle collapse / expand · click an item to select it (see the log) · drag the “animation duration” slider to see the transition
